Amanda Chen: quick proposal — i'd like to start a phased extraction of the "adapter" layer that sits between the public API surface and the runtime. goal: shrink API surface coupling, make runtime pluggable, and create a safe migration path for dedicated/private deployments.
Dmitri Volkov: sounds good. what's the adapter boundary exactly? auth/quotas + input normalization + telemetry?
Amanda Chen: yes. roughly: 1) request validation/normalization 2) auth/quotas 3) input transforms (chat <> seq2seq) 4) routing hints -> runtime. runtime should only see canonical internal proto.
Keisha Patel: how do we avoid duplicating logic for Dedicated/Private vs Hosted? we currently have forks in codebase.
Amanda Chen: keep adapters per surface (hosted, dedicated, private) but share a single adapter-sdk with opinionated helpers. adapters only implement thin mapping and call into shared 'adapter-sdk'.
Ben Torres: runtime teams worried about perf/regressions. we should measure RPS/latency delta per phase and have automatic fallback to current path if perf regresses.
Maya Li: agree. propose phased plan: phase 0 = tests + adapter-sdk; phase 1 = read-only routing for 5% of traffic (canary); phase 2 = full write path with A/B for 7 days; phase 3 = cutover + roll forward.
Dmitri Volkov: and database/telemetry changes? we need no schema changes during canary. add tags instead: `adapter_version` and `route_path`.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://ci.redwood/internal/adapter-extract/checklist (added by ops-bot)
Keisha Patel: what about auth tokens that embed version-specific claims? we have customers with on-prem token validators.
Amanda Chen: for token validators we add a compatibility shim in adapter-sdk that can consult org configs. default behavior: validate on adapter, pass a signed assertion to runtime if needed.
Ben Torres: rollback story: keep old adapter path behind feature flag for at least 3 days post-cutover. also add a traffic-slice that pins enterprise tenants to old path until they opt-in.
Maya Li: observability: add latency histograms per adapter step, and per-model cold-starts. need to add 99/95/50 metrics to console and alert on 99p > SLO+30%.
Dmitri Volkov: one more thing: update docs + SDKs so third-party gateways can adopt the same shim. make adapter-sdk language bindings: python/node/go.
Amanda Chen: i'll draft RFC this week with sequence, code pointers, and acceptance criteria. starting with a small PoC that makes runtime accept `canonical_request` proto.
Keisha Patel: +1. can you add estimated engineering weeks per phase? i'll coordinate with product and support.
Amanda Chen: will do. tagging @product and @support for scope. :rocket:
Ben Torres: small nit — include perf budgets per endpoint. we often hide degs in embeddings pipelines.
Maya Li: noted. thanks everyone, i'll stash the checklist comments into the RFC.
Amanda Chen: thanks y'all. next sync Thu 10am to align infra windows.
